units: <cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 3:1">Mikv. III, 1</cite>, sq. <he>עד שיצא ממנו מְלוֹאוֹ ועוד</he> until a quantity equal to its original contents and something besides have run off.
Y. Succ. I, 51ᵈ top אכסדרה שנפרצה במְלוֹאָהּ וכ׳ an exedra which is (on one side) entirely open towards the public road.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 1:1:3">Ib.</cite> bot. <he>כמְלוֹאוֹ של דלי</he> as far as the bucket is let down into the water (for filling it).
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 2:3">Ḥull. II, 3</cite> <he>אם יש בסכין מְלֹא צואר</he> if the slaughtering knife has the length of the width of the neck.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 33a:13">Kidd. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ עיניו</he> as far as his eye can reach.
<cite ref="Shabbat 30a">Sabb. 30ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>כמ׳ נימא</he> as much as a hair’s breadth.

<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 160:14">Sifré Num. 160</cite> (expl. <he>אבן יד</he>, <cite ref="Numbers 35:17">Num. XXXV, 17</cite>) <he>מ׳ יד</he> as large as the grasp of the hand; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 17:3">Tosef. Ohol. XVII, 3</cite> <he>מ׳ טימיא</he>, v. <cite ref="L00383"><he>לָטוֹמְיָא</he></cite>.]
